apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: ClusterIssuer
metadata: { name: letsencrypt-prod }
spec:
  acme:
    server: https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory
    email: {{email}}
    privateKeySecretRef: { name: letsencrypt-prod-key }
    solvers:
      - http01:
          ingress:
            class: nginx
